reason: Critical functionality is still missing (no run loop, no metrics, main() no-op). With only two iterations remaining, a focused pass can implement the daily simulation loop, parameter mapping, supply/adoption gating, and core metrics to pass verification. There is clear potential for significant improvement with one more iteration, and possibly a final polish in the last iteration.

specific_areas: Implement Simulation.run() with a daily pipeline: policy updates, peer influence computation, authority/media signals, information diffusion with media reach, latent attitude update with decay, adoption intent, demand formation, market update + allocation, enforcement visits, fatigue/habit updates, and metrics logging.
Populate main() to load params (stdin JSON), construct Simulation with spec-to-internal parameter mapping, call run(), and print JSON results.

Map spec parameters to internal names in Simulation.__init__ (random_seed->seed, simulation_duration_days->time_horizon_days, supply_restock_rate_per_day->production_rate, enforcement_probability, campaign_start_day, misinformation_start_day, time_step_days).
Refactor SupplyMarket.update_daily() to stop subtracting sold units; let allocate() handle stock decrement to prevent double counting; adjust price based on demand pressure and restock.
Gate adoption by inventory: agents cannot adopt without masks; queue demand, allocate, then set adoption_state.

Compute and return required metrics: adoption_rate_over_time, final_adoption_rate, peak_adoption_rate with day, time_to_50_percent_adoption, compliance_rate_under_mandate, violation_rate, adoption_by_location_type, and adoption_logistic_fit_r2.
Implement campaign_effect_lift via a quick counterfactual run (same seed/network, campaign_intensity=0) and report lift on final or post-campaign average adoption.
Respect media reach by applying media signals to a subset of agents proportional to reach, and include influence_decay_per_day in latent attitude updates.
Add simple capacity handling in visits/enforcement and aggregate compliance/violations by location type.
Clean up unused imports and stale docstrings if time permits.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Validate metric sanity (values in [0,1], peak/day indices valid, time_to_50% either int or null) and compute logistic_fit_r2 for QA.
